# Journalism Google v2.0.1

> Useful TypeScript functions for journalism projects. This library focuses on accessing Google services.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-google/v2.0.1/README.md): Installation, examples and usage.

## API
- [deleteFromBucket](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-google/v2.0.1/docs/functions/deleteFromBucket.md): deleteFromBucket function
- [downloadFromBucket](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-google/v2.0.1/docs/functions/downloadFromBucket.md): downloadFromBucket function
- [filesInBucket](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-google/v2.0.1/docs/functions/filesInBucket.md): filesInBucket function
- [getSheetData](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-google/v2.0.1/docs/functions/getSheetData.md): getSheetData function
- [inBucket](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-google/v2.0.1/docs/functions/inBucket.md): inBucket function
- [openSpreadsheet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-google/v2.0.1/docs/functions/openSpreadsheet.md): openSpreadsheet function
- [pushToSheet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-google/v2.0.1/docs/functions/pushToSheet.md): pushToSheet function
- [toBucket](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-google/v2.0.1/docs/functions/toBucket.md): toBucket function
